title: Convergence Analysis of Newton Methods for Nonlinear Optimal Control Problems
summary: The main purpose of this paper is to establish the local quadratic convergence of Newton's method for nonlinear optimal control problems. Under suitable smoothness assumptions, the cost functional is first shown to be twice G{â}teaux differentiable with respect to the control. An explicit operator representation of its second derivative is derived, and its continuity in different control spaces is examined.
